description: A `<*f/>` cycle through a declaration's render: a program field's state arm mounts `<card/>`, whose render shows that same field: E-DECL-RENDER-CYCLE-STAR (#2139 review MED-1).
provenance: ruling:user-voice-scrml.md-S483-star-self-render-error ("every such cycle ... is a compile error ... it is the same field of the same instance at every level ... Guards do not make it legal.")
rationale: §66.6.2 rule 1 (S483 r1): "The cycle may run through a declaration's render" — the program's field is one instance at every level.
